article_content: The four surviving original copies of the Magna Carta have been brought together for the first time since 1215 at The British Library in London. The Magna Carta, or 'Great Charter', was agreed upon by King John on June 15, 1215, at Runnymede. Only three of the original 63 clauses remain on the statute books today.

article_content: Some southern US states experienced unseasonal snow on Tuesday, causing flight cancellations and school closures. A winter storm warning was issued for parts of Alabama, Georgia, Tennessee, Kentucky, and the Carolinas by the National Weather Service. Areas north and west of metro Atlanta received snow, while the city saw mostly rain with temperatures just above freezing. AirTran Airways canceled 69 flights to and from Atlanta, with more cancellations possible. Delta Airlines canceled around 250 flights from Atlanta. The National Weather Service forecasted 2 to 4 inches of snow in areas along and north of I-85.

Atlantan pohjois- ja länsiosat saivat lunta, kun taas itse kaupunki koki enimmäkseen sadetta lämpötilan ollessa juuri nollan yläpuolella. AirTran Airways peruutti 69 lentoa Atlantaan ja sieltä pois, ja lisää perumisia on odotettavissa. Delta Airlines ilmoitti peruneensa noin 250 lentoa Atlantasta. National Weather Service ennusti 2-4 tuumaa lunta I-85:n varrella ja sen pohjoispuolella.

article_content: A suicide bomber killed 38 people and wounded 56 others in a town near Baghdad on Wednesday, according to police. The attacker detonated explosives near 'Awakening Council' members in al-Madaan, about 20 kilometers southeast of Baghdad, as they were collecting their monthly paychecks. The 'Awakening Councils' are predominantly Sunni Arab fighters who turned against al Qaeda in late 2006. The U.S.-backed movement is credited with contributing to a drop in violence across Iraq. However, council members have become targets for jihadists, notably the Sunni extremist group ISIS, which has seized key areas of Iraqi territory this year. The majority of the casualties were reported to be 'Awakening Council' members.

'Awakening Council' -järjestö koostuu pääasiassa sunni-arabilaisista taistelijoista, jotka päättivät kääntyä al-Qaidaa vastaan vuoden 2006 lopulla. Yhdysvaltojen tukema liike on saanut kunnian osaltaan Irakin väkivallan vähenemisestä. Kuitenkin järjestön jäsenet ovat nousseet jihadistien, erityisesti sunnilaisen äärijärjestö ISIS:n, kohteiksi. Järjestö on vallannut tärkeitä alueita Irakissa tänä vuonna. Suurin osa uhreista oli 'Awakening Council' -järjestön jäseniä.

article_content: 'Your bathroom is becoming a refuge, so why not light it adequately?' When it comes to interior lighting, bathrooms are often given the least consideration. 'I see a lot of baths with inadequate lighting at the mirror,' says the expert. A good lighting plan involves layers: task lighting for showers and grooming, ambient lighting to substitute natural light, and accent lighting to highlight decor. Task lighting, particularly around the vanity, is crucial. Using sconces or vertical fixtures on either side of the mirror, 36 to 40 inches apart and at eye level (about 66 inches above the floor), provides even lighting. For the shower, a recessed light with a glass lens is recommended. Ambient lighting can be achieved with a central fixture or creative options like pendant lamps or cove lighting. Accent lighting highlights decorative art or nice tilework. Choosing the right bulbs, like halogen or compact fluorescents, and using dimmers enhances the lighting's functionality and mood. Safety is also key, with GFCI outlets required near water sources.
translated_content: 'Kylpyhuoneestasi on tulossa rauhallinen turvapaikka, joten miksi et valaisisi sitä riittävästi?' Sisustuksessa kylpyhuoneiden valaistus jää usein viimeiseksi. 'Huomasin, että monissa kylpyhuoneissa peilin valaistus on riittämätön,' sanoo asiantuntija. Hyvä valaistus suunnitellaan kerroksittain: tehtävään sopiva valaistus suihkulle ja henkilökohtaisiin hoitotoimenpiteisiin, yleisvalaistus luonnonvalon korvaajaksi, ja korostusvalaistus koristeluun. Tehtävään sopiva valaistus, erityisesti peilin ympärillä, on ratkaisevän tärkeää. Sconceja tai pystysuuntaisia valaisimia peilin molemmin puolin, 36-40 tuuman välein ja silmien tasolla (noin 66 tuumaa lattiasta), tarjoaa tasaisen valaistuksen. Suihkussa on suositeltavaa käyttää upotettua valaisinta lasilinssillä. Yleisvalaistus voidaan toteuttaa keskeisellä valaisimella tai luovilla ratkaisuilla, kuten riippuvalaisimella tai kattovalolla. Korostusvalaistus korostaa koristeellisia elementtejä tai kaunista laatoitusta. Oikeiden lamppujen, kuten halogeenien tai kompaktien loisteputkien, valitseminen ja himmentimien käyttö parantavat valaistuksen toimivuutta ja tunnelmaa. Turvallisuus on myös avainasemassa, ja GFCI-pistorasiat ovat pakollisia vesilähteiden lähellä.

article_content: Lee Westwood had a remarkable day at the CIMB Classic on Friday, carding a hole-in-one that propelled him into contention at the Kuala Lumpur Golf and Country Club. Using a hybrid club on the 226-yard 11th hole, Westwood struck his tee shot perfectly, watching as it landed 10 feet from the pin before rolling into the hole. 'That was a pretty special day,' Westwood tweeted. 'It's not often you see them go in from 226 yards!' Westwood finished his round with a flawless 65, including three birdies on the front nine and additional ones on the 16th and 18th holes, leaving him seven under par and tied for third place with several other golfers.

Westwood käytti 226 jaardin 11. reiällä hybridimailaa ja lyöi tiitteen täydellisesti, ja pallo laskeutui 10 jalan päähän reiästä ennen kuin vieri reikään. 'Tämä oli melko erikoinen päivä,' Westwood twiittasi. 'Ei ole usein, että näkee pallon menevän reikään 226 jaardin päästä!' article_content: Jasper Allibone's parents claim that St George's Hospital failed to detect a genetic fault before his birth, leading to his death at three months old. They are suing the hospital for £300,000 for failing to provide a 'competent standard of care'. Catherine Allibone, 34, had tests during her previous pregnancy that were not properly scrutinised, and as a result, no tests were done to check if Jasper had inherited her rare genetic abnormality. Jasper was born in September 2009 with severe brain and physical disabilities.

article_content: These photos show the extraordinary lengths a commuter in Vietnam will go to avoid making more than one journey. The astonishing images were captured by photographer Renato Navarro while he travelled along a busy road from the Mekong river to Ho Chi Minh City in southern Vietnam. With up to 40 geese bursting out of baskets precariously balanced on his bike, the motorist looks remarkably calm and balanced. Sights like these are commonplace in Vietnam, where most people ride mopeds and motorbikes. Mr Navarro, 37, from Sao Paulo, Brazil, said that when he saw the rider, he couldn't resist taking a picture. He said: 'The traffic was horrible; we were going around 6mph or less. I was stuck in the traffic for more than three hours, but when I saw the funny geese, I thought it was worth it. The noise in Vietnam is huge from motorbikes and cars, so if they made noise, I believe they wouldn't even hear it. I wouldn't dare to drive a motorbike in Vietnam - it's crazy!' Mr Navarro, who takes pictures around the world, got the shots while spending a week in Vietnam on a photography trip with friends.
translated_content: Nämä kuvat osoittavat, mihin pituuksiin vietnamilainen päivittäismatkustaja menee välttääkseen useamman kuin yhden matkan. Upeat kuvat otti valokuvaaja Renato Navarro matkustaessaan vilkkaalta tieltä Mekong-joelta Ho Chi Minh Cityyn Vietnamin eteläosaan. Kun jopa 40 hanhia pursuaa koreista, jotka ovat vaarallisesti tasapainossa hänen pyörällään, moottoripyöräilijä näyttää huomattavan rauhalliselta ja tasapainoiselta. Tällaiset näyt ovat arkipäivää Vietnamissa, missä useimmat ihmiset ajaa mopolla ja moottoripyörällä. Herra Navarro, 37, Sao Paulosta, Brasiliasta, sanoi, että kun hän näki ajajan, hän ei voinut vastustaa kuvan ottamista. Hän sanoi: 'Liikenne oli kauheaa; kuljimme noin 6 mailia tunnissa tai vähemmän. Olin jumissa liikenteessä yli kolme tuntia, mutta kun näin hauskat hanhet, ajattelin sen olleen vaivan arvoista. Melu Vietnamissa on moottoripyörien ja autojen takia valtavaa, joten jos ne tekisivät melua, luulen, että ne eivät kuulisivat sitä edes. En uskalla ajaa moottoripyörällä Vietnamissa - se on hullua!' Herra Navarro, joka ottaa kuvia ympäri maailmaa, sai kuvat viikon mittaisella valokuvausmatkallaan ystävien kanssa Vietnamissa.

article_content: (CNN) -- Escaped Michigan convict Michael David Elliot was captured on Monday in LaPorte County, Indiana, authorities said. His capture followed a manhunt that intensified after a woman abducted by Elliot managed to call 911 from a gas station bathroom. 'He didn't say where, exactly, he just said somewhere far,' she whispered during the call. The woman had been abducted at around 8 p.m. on Sunday with a box cutter and a hammer. She escaped when they stopped for gas and hid in the bathroom. 'He's knocking on the bathroom door saying, 'Let's go!'' the 911 dispatcher informed other emergency workers. Elliot, a convicted murderer, had escaped from Ionia Correctional Facility in central Michigan on Sunday. On Monday, a homeowner in LaGrange County found the woman's Jeep Liberty in Shipshewana, about 20 miles east of Elkhart. Elliot was serving five life sentences for killing four people in 1993. Authorities had warned the public not to approach him.

Hänen kiinniottamisensa seurasi laajaa etsintää, joka voimistui, kun Elliotin sieppaama nainen soitti hätänumeroon huoltoaseman vessasta. 'Hän ei sanonut minne, hän sanoi vain jonnekin kauas,' hän sanoi puhelussa. Nainen oli siepattu sunnuntaina iltapäivällä veitsen ja vasaran avulla. Hän pakeni huoltoasemalle ja piiloutui vessaan. 'Hän koputtaa vessan oveen sanomalla 'Lähdetään!'' 911-hätäpuhelun vastaanottaja sanoi muille hätätyöntekijöille. Elliot, tuomittu murhaaja, oli paennut Ionia Correctional Facility -vankilasta sunnuntaina. Maanantaina LaGrange Countysta löytyi naisen Jeep Liberty Shipshewanasta. Elliot oli tuomittu elinkautiseen neljästä murhasta vuonna 1993. Viranomaiset varoittivat yleisöä olemaan lähestymättä häntä.

article_content: By David Williams. UPDATED: 10:51 EST, 14 January 2012. Foreign Secretary William Hague appealed for calm in Pakistan yesterday amid growing fears the army is preparing to seize control in a military coup. Hours after beleaguered Prime Minister Yousuf Reza Gilani was reported to have made a 'panicky' telephone call to the British High Commissioner in Islamabad appealing for UK help, Mr Hague said: 'While clearly there is tension, a lot of risks, we must not talk up those risks.' The decision comes at a time of intense friction over an unsigned memo that sought U.S. help in reining in Pakistan's generals. The army has warned of 'serious ramifications with potentially grievous consequences' after its defence chief was fired. Mr Hague played down coup fears. Tension was 'very serious', said a top military official in Pakistan. The Pakistan leader's fears are not unfounded; the Army has staged four coups in Pakistan's history. The latest flare-up centres on an unsigned memo sent to Washington asking for help to head off a supposed coup following the U.S. raid that led to the death of Osama bin Laden. The Supreme Court is investigating the memo and has ordered corruption investigations into President Asif Ali Zardari.

Pääministeri Yousuf Reza Gilani oli ilmoittanut tehneensä 'hätääntyneen' puhelun Britannian korkeaan edustajaan Islamabadissa ja pyytäneen apua. Hague sanoi, että 'on jännitystä ja riskejä, mutta meidän ei pidä korostaa niitä.' Armeija on varoittanut 'vakavista seurauksista' sen jälkeen, kun sen puolustusjohtaja erotettiin.

article_content: When David Letterman announced his retirement on 'Late Show with David Letterman', citing his age and desire to spend time with his family, it's 'hard to argue with'. However, an unstated reason is likely the rise of newer late-night TV hosts and changing viewer habits due to the Internet. The way viewers consume late-night TV has shifted from full shows to 'bite-size bits' and viral videos. Letterman, known for his multicourse format, has been a late-night host for over three decades, longer than anyone else in the job. His legacy includes producing memorable programs and classic television moments. The introduction of Jimmy Fallon as the new host of 'The Tonight Show' may have influenced Letterman's decision. In the current landscape, Fallon's 'The Tonight Show' draws more viewers than Letterman's show. The article suggests that the real shift isn't in who's watching but in who's not watching, as younger viewers prefer content to be shared on social media or news sites rather than watching the full show. Letterman's style, seeing his show as a complete one-hour entity, may be at odds with the modern preference for viral clips.
translated_content: Kun David Letterman ilmoitti jäävänsä eläkkeelle 'Late Show with David Letterman' -ohjelmassa, vedoten ikäänsä ja haluun viettää aikaa perheensä kanssa, on 'vaikea olla eri mieltä'. Todennäköisesti syy on kuitenkin uuden sukupolven iltauutisten juontajien nousu ja internetin vaikutus katsojien tottumuksiin. Nyt katsojat kuluttavat iltauutisia yhä enemmän 'pieninä palasina' ja virusvideoina täysien ohjelmien sijaan. Letterman on ollut iltauutisten juontajana yli kolme vuosikymmentä, pidempään kuin kukaan muu. Hänen perintöönsä kuuluu muistettavia ohjelmia ja klassisia tv-hetkiä. Jimmy Fallonin nimittäminen 'The Tonight Show'n' juontajaksi saattoi vaikuttaa Lettermanin päätökseen. Nykytilanteessa Fallonin 'The Tonight Show' kerää enemmän katsojia kuin Lettermanin ohjelma. Artikkeli viittaa siihen, että muutos ei ole niinkään siinä, kuka katsoo, vaan kuka ei katso: nuoremmat katsojat haluavat sisällön jaettuna sosiaalisessa mediassa tai uutissivustoilla ennemmin kuin katsomalla koko ohjelman. Lettermanin tyyli, jossa hän näkee ohjelmansa yhtenäisenä tunnin kokonaisuutena, voi olla ristiriidassa nykyajan preferenssin kanssa, joka suosii lyhyitä viruspätkiä.

article_content: Dali defied death once, on the day he was born. He was found lying in the middle of a street on a terribly cold winter night in Delhi, abandoned or lost. He looked more like a mouse than a puppy, being only a few hours old. A murder of crows and a pack of dogs, belonging to an aunt walking them, showed curiosity towards him. The aunt picked up the lifeless body to save it from indignity, and just then, he opened his mouth; his eyes opened a fortnight later. He was revived with the warmth of a hot water bottle. Dali was an unusual dog, reared by his human parents with bottled milk and cerelac. He didn't have the fortune of being reared by his biological mother. For a long time, he turned away when he saw another dog. Later, he would sneer at his fellow dogs. Dali acquired a 'human core'; he communicated clearly, expressing his pleasure and displeasure. He had a language of his own, a melody of guttural sounds, not a bark. He also picked up the human instinct of distrust. Dali could tell the difference between good and bad people. His aggression, backed by reason, made him legendary outside his nuclear family. To his owners, he was a dog, friend, child, and boss all rolled into one. They named him Dali because his tiny face and body were strikingly painted in three hues: dark brown, light brown, and white. Dali didn't want to hear 'no'; his first bark was provoked by a pointed finger asking him to sit down. He had a mind of his own, and more than a dozen trainers were sent packing. One trainer, who trained police dogs, wondered why they needed a trainer at all since Dali was highly intelligent and protective of his family without training. Dali always had the 'hand of the divine' on him. When he was a few months old, he wandered off and got lost. A frantic search ensued, but their cook, who was fond of Dali, meditated in his room and later found Dali exactly where he had envisioned him to be. Dali had a high IQ and an exemplary EQ. During Covid, he sensed his owners' anxiety and stress, being a constant calming influence. Their brief walks with him were a break from the bleak reality. As they watched the flames engulf his pyre, there were tears, but also a reminder of a feisty, defiant, and loving dog who lit up their lives.
translated_content: Dali uhmasi kuoleman kerran, syntymäpäivänään. Hän makasi keskellä kadulla hirveän kylmällä talvi-iltana Delhissä, hylättynä tai ehkä eksyneenä. Hän näytti enemmän hiireltä kuin pennulta, vain muutaman tunnin ikäisenä. Varisten parvi ja koirien lauma, jotka kuuluivat tätä ulkoiluttavalle tädille, olivat uteliaita hänen kohdallaan. Täti kumartui nostamaan hengettömän ruumiin säästääkseen sen nöyryyttämiseltä, ja juuri silloin hän avasi suunsa; hänen silmänsä avautuivat vasta kaksi viikkoa myöhemmin. Hän heräsi henkiin kuumavesipullon lämmön avulla. Dali oli epätavallinen koira, jonka hänen ihmisvanhempansa kasvattivat pulloruokinnalla ja viljajauheella. Hänellä ei ollut onnea tulla kasvaneeksi biologisen äitinsä luona. Pitkän aikaa hän kääntyi pois nähdessään toisen koiran. Myöhemmin hän halveksui muita koiria. Dali sai 'ihmisytimen'; hän kommunikoi selvästi, ilmaisemalla mieltymyksensä ja epämieltymyksensä. Hänellä oli oma kielensä, kurkkuääneten melodia, ei haukuntaa. Hän myös omaksui ihmisille ominaisen epäluulon vaiston. Dali pystyi erottamaan hyvät ja pahat ihmiset. Hänen aggressionsa, jota järki tuki, teki hänestä legendaarisen hänen ydinperheensä ulkopuolella. Omistajilleen hän oli koira, ystävä, lapsi ja pomo kaikki yhdessä. He nimittivät hänet Daliksi, koska hänen pieni kasvoensa ja vartalonsa olivat silmiinpistävän kolmiväriset: tummanruskea, vaaleanruskea ja valkoinen. Dali ei halunnut kuulla 'ei'; hänen ensimmäinen haukuntansa sai alkunsa, kun sormella osoitettiin häntä istumaan. Hänellä oli oma tahtonsa, ja yli kymmenen kouluttajaa lähetettiin menemään. Eräs kouluttaja, joka koulutti poliisikoiraa, ihmetteli, miksi he halusivat kouluttajan ylipäänsä, koska Dali oli erittäin älykäs ja suojeli perhettään ilman koulutusta. Dali aina 'jumalan käsi' oli hänen kanssaan. Kun hän oli muutaman kuukauden ikäinen, hän harhaili pois ja eksyi. Kiivasta etsintää seurasi, mutta heidän kokkinsa, joka piti Dalista, meditoi huoneessaan ja löysi myöhemmin Dalin täsmälleen siellä, missä hän oli hänet nähnyt. Dali oli korkeasti älykäs ja hänellä oli esimerkillinen tunneäly. Koronaviruksen aikana hän aisti omistajiensa ahdistuksen ja stressin, ollessaan jatkuva rauhoittava vaikutus. Heidän lyhyet kävelynsä hänen kanssaan olivat tauko synkästä todellisuudesta. Kun he katsoivat liekkien nielaisseen hänen ruumiinsa, oli kyyneliä, mutta myös muistutus iloisesta, uhmaavasta ja rakastavasta koirasta, joka valaisi heidän elämäänsä.

article_content: The remains of 55 people have been unearthed from a graveyard at the former 'Arthur G. Dozier School for Boys', a reform school known for its history of abuse. Researchers from the 'University of South Florida' began and completed the excavation between September and December. Despite official records indicating 31 burials, researchers had estimated around 50 graves. The bodies were interred between the late 1920s and early 1950s. The researchers aim to identify the remains and determine the causes of death.

Virallisten tietojen mukaan hautausmaalle oli haudattu 31 henkilöä, mutta tutkijat arvioivat hautojen määräksi noin 50. Ruumiit oli haudattu 1920-luvun lopun ja 1950-luvun alun välisenä aikana. Tutkijat pyrkivät tunnistamaan jäännökset ja selvittämään kuolinsyyt.

General Shelton stated that potential adversaries are studying U.S. procedures to identify weaknesses. At George Washington University, he said, 'Our dependence on space has become quite a double-edged sword.' The U.S. plans to move away from large satellite constructions towards less complex designs with multiple components to enhance security. He highlighted the critical role of satellite technology in various situations, including humanitarian crises like Hurricane Katrina and the Japanese tsunami.

Kenraali Shelton totesi, että vastustajat tutkivat Yhdysvaltain menettelytapoja löytääkseen heikkouksia. article_content: When Sumo the cat was brought into the RSPCA last week, he became the fattest cat to have visited their doors for decades. Vicki Lomax, RSPCA veterinarian, said 'He is the biggest cat I've ever seen in my 45 years as a vet.' Sumo, a nine-year-old domestic short hair cat, weighs 14.3kg, nearly three times his ideal weight of 5-6 kg. Tanya Boland, a vet nurse from the RSPCA, is caring for Sumo and has put him on a strict diet. Sumo is at risk of diabetes, heart disease, liver disease, kidney disease, and arthritis due to his weight. To check if a cat is overweight, owners should feel the skin over their ribs and monitor their weight. Sumo's previous owners couldn't take him when they moved house, so he was brought to the RSPCA and named Sumo due to his size. Sumo is being fed less than two cups of low-calorie dry cat food per day and is expected to lose about 250g per week.

Sumo, yhdeksänvuotias kotimainen lyhytkarvainen kissa, painaa 14.3kg, lähes kolme kertaa hänen ihannepainonsa 5-6 kg. Tanya Boland, RSPCA:n eläinhoitaja, hoitaa Sumoa ja on asettanut hänet tiukalle ruokavaliolle. Sumo on vaarassa sairastua diabetekseen, sydän-, maksa- ja munuaissairauksiin sekä nivelrikkoon painonsa vuoksi. Kissan omistajien tulisi tunnustella kissansa kylkiluiden päällä olevaa ihoa ja seurata niiden painoa. article_content: A midwife, Joanne Scott, is facing a misconduct hearing for allegedly pouring milk over a distressed baby's face and saying 'that's for throwing up on me'. The incident occurred during a night shift at the Queen Elizabeth Hospital in Gateshead in 2008. Scott is also accused of taking a photo of the baby with her mobile phone to share with her family. The hearing has been told that Scott's actions were witnessed by a colleague who initially didn't report the incident due to being junior to Scott. article_content: The risk of Islamic radicalization within U.S. prisons was a topic of debate during a House Homeland Security Committee hearing led by Rep. Peter King. King asserted that the danger 'remains real and present,' while others, like Bert Useem, argued that the actual risk is minimal. Democrats on the committee, including Rep. Bennie Thompson and Rep. Laura Richardson, criticized the hearing for its exclusive focus on Muslim radicalization, suggesting this focus could be perceived as discriminatory. Witnesses, including Michael Downing of the Los Angeles Police Department, advocated for a more in-depth examination of the issue and the establishment of standards for vetting prison chaplains and materials.

article_content: By Carla Babb November 15, 2023 Attacks from Iranian-backed militants have escalated, with a multi-rocket attack coming within a half-kilometer of Mission Support Site Euphrates in eastern Syria on Tuesday, 'putting US troops on high alert'. The U.S. says deterrence is 'partially effective' with Iran, and on Sunday the military struck two facilities used by Iran and Iranian-backed militant groups in Syria. Defense officials tell VOA Iranian-backed militants have attacked U.S. troops in Iraq and Syria at least '70 times' in less than a month, with at least five attacks happening after the Sunday strikes. 'Is deterrence working? We feel that it is,' said Pentagon Deputy Press Secretary Sabrina Singh, 'but we are still on 'high alert'.' Singh acknowledged that Iranian-affiliated groups have continued to attack American troops, but said the U.S. strategy is 'showing some positive results'. More than 50 Americans suffered 'severe' injuries to traumatic brain injuries from the attacks before returning to duty, officials say. A bipartisan group of senators told reporters Tuesday the U.S. is 'lucky' that no Americans have died from the attacks and called for a 'much stronger' response against Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, or IRGC. 'If Iran continues to threaten our troops in Syria and Iraq, the right response militarily would be in my view to hit the IRGC training bases and infrastructure inside of Iran,' said Senator Lindsey Graham.

Yhdysvallat sanoo, että pelote on 'osittain tehokas' Iranin kanssa, ja sunnuntaina sotilas iski kahteen Iranin ja Iranin tukeman militanttiryhmän käyttämään laitokseen Syyriassa. Puolustusviranomaiset kertovat VOA:lle, että Iranin tukemat militantit ovat hyökänneet Yhdysvaltain joukkoja vastaan Irakissa ja Syyriassa ainakin '70 kertaa' kuukauden sisällä, ja ainakin viisi hyökkäystä tapahtui sunnuntain iskujen jälkeen. 'Toimiiko pelote? Me katsomme, että se toimii,' sanoi Pentagonin apulaislehdistövirkailija Sabrina Singh, 'mutta olemme edelleen 'korkeassa valmiudessa'.' Singh myönsi, että Iranin tukemat ryhmät ovat jatkuvasti hyökänneet amerikkalaista joukkoja vastaan, mutta sanoi, että Yhdysvaltain strategia 'näyttää joitakin myönteisiä tuloksia'. Yli 50 amerikkalaista sai 'vakavia' vammoja aivotärähdyksiin hyökkäyksissä ennen kuin palasivat tehtäviinsä, viranomaiset sanovat. Kaksipuolueinen senaattoryhmä kertoi toimittajille tiistaina, että Yhdysvallat on 'onnekas', ettei amerikkalaisia ole kuollut hyökkäyksissä, ja vaati 'paljon voimakkaampaa' vastausta Iraniin liittyvää vallankumouskaarti IRGC:tä vastaan. 'Jos Iran jatkaa joukkojemme uhkaamista Syyriassa ja Irakissa, oikea sotilaallinen vastaus olisi mielestäni hyökätä IRGC:n koulutusleireihin ja infrastruktuuriin Iranin sisällä,' sanoi senaattori Lindsey Graham.

article_content: EQS-Media / 02.11.2023 / 09:20 CET/CEST All for One Group to drastically expand its top management amid 'critical' financial situation Filderstadt, 2 November 2023 – Effective 1 November 2023, All for One Group SE is making a 'desperate' attempt to expand its top management. Alongside Co-CEOs Lars Landwehrkamp and Michael Zitz and CFO Stefan Land, Group Executives Ursula Porth (CHRO), Christian Hopfner (CSO), Carsten Lange (CCO) and Ralf Linha (COO) will assume responsibility for the business, staff and further expansion of All for One Group in the future. In the process, the areas of responsibility of Carsten Lange and Ralf Linha are to be 'significantly' expanded. The positions of Chief Human Resources Officer and Chief Strategy Officer are being newly created and will be occupied by two 'highly experienced' managers – Ursula Porth and Christian Hopfner. Experienced manager Ursula Porth is joining the Group from Software AG, where she was most recently responsible for global business partnering, talent acquisition, people development, global learning and culture as Senior Vice President HR. As CHRO at All for One Group, Ursula Porth will be in charge of all aspects and areas of HR and will be responsible for the Group-wide workforce of some 3,000 employees. 'I am very much looking forward to working with my HR team and my executive colleagues to contribute sustainably to the success of the company and to drive the progress of All for One in becoming a coveted employer at international level. Given the 'dire' international expansion and strong growth of the Group, especially, there is a need to align structures, transparency and agility. In doing so, we must make sure the employees are on board, and must nurture high potentials and the unique culture of the Group', is how Ursula Porth defines the key cornerstones of her new role as All for One CHRO. As Chief Strategy Officer, Christian Hopfner will be responsible for the future strategy and portfolio, IT and processes, and the ecosystem of the Group. The experienced managed has been with All for One since 2014, during which time his achievements included the successful establishment and expansion of corporate development within the Group. Prior to joining All for One, he spent 14 years working as an international project manager in the SAP environment in Switzerland. 'When debating changes, decisions and developments, I too place great importance on making sure I always consider the interests of all colleagues and get them on board. After all, ultimately, they form the foundations on which to build the success of our company', is how Christian Hopfner underscores the people-first strategy for driving the Group’s progress. As part of the move to expand the top management, the areas of responsibility of Group Executives Carsten Lange and Ralf Linha will also be expanded. As Chief Commercial Officer, Carsten Lange will assume responsibility throughout the Group for customers, markets and project business. As COO, Ralf Linha’s responsibilities will include delivery, services & support, technology and cloud strategy for the Group as a whole. Co-CEO Michael Zitz: 'All for One Group has a clear set of targets – focusing on customers and markets, focusing on investors, and as an employer. By expanding our top management, we have the ideal structure and are highly motivated to position and establish All for One as an international IT, consulting and service provider. We want to be indispensable for our customers, to appeal equally to both our existing staff and high potentials, and to arouse substantial interest among investors. I am utterly convinced that we can and will achieve these three goals sustainably with the help of all staff members.'  About All for One Group SE All for One Group increases the competitiveness of companies in a digital world. The Group unites strategic and management consulting, process consulting, industry insight and technology expertise in combination with IT consulting and services under one roof. With market leading business software solutions based on SAP, Microsoft and IBM together with around 2,800 experts, All for One Group SE orchestrates all aspects of competitive strength: strategy, business model, customer & employee experience, new work, big data & analytics, but also IoT, artificial intelligence or cybersecurity & compliance and intelligent ERP as the digital core. The leading consulting and IT group supports more than 3,000 clients from Germany, Austria, Poland and Switzerland in their business transformation.
